mapper.select: select * from oc_document_index_generation where document_version_id = #{versionId} and status != 'DELETED' order by create_time desc, generation_id
mapper.insert: insert into oc_document_index_generation (generation_id, document_id, document_version_id, knowledge_base_id, brand_id, model_id, parse_id, parsed_object_key, profile, status, create_by) values (#{generationId}, #{documentId}, #{documentVersionId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{brandId}, #{modelId}, #{parseId}, #{parsedObjectKey}, #{profile}, 'BUILDING', #{createBy})
mapper.update: update oc_document_index_generation g inner join oc_document_version v on v.document_version_id = g.document_version_id inner join oc_document d on d.document_id = g.document_id inner join oc_knowledge_base k on k.knowledge_base_id = d.knowledge_base_id set g.status = 'READY', g.manifest_json = #{manifestJson}, g.update_time = sysdate() where g.generation_id = #{generationId} and g.status = 'BUILDING' and v.del_flag = '0' and v.process_status = '2' and v.parsed_object_key = g.parsed_object_key and d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and k.del_flag = '0' and k.status = '0' and k.knowledge_base_id = g.knowledge_base_id and k.brand_id = g.brand_id and k.model_id = g.model_id
update oc_document_index_generation set status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = sysdate() where generation_id = #{generationId} and status = 'BUILDING'
update oc_document_index_generation set status = 'DELETED', update_time = sysdate() where document_version_id = #{versionId} and status != 'DELETED'
